reason: I already keep a spreadsheet and it works, so I'd have to switch habits for a slip scanner and a statement import. The card import is the only part I'd actually want, and I'd only pay for it after the free trial proves it gets the categories right.
objection: Uploading my card statement and bank slips to a new website, even with the PDF read in my browser and the data said to be encrypted, and the trust that I'd have to put in a small app I've never heard of.
would_change_my_mind: If the free trial correctly categorised my own card statement with little fixing, so that it saved me more time each month than the spreadsheet costs me.
